svg.aria-label: fig. 44 — What can actually be tested
svg.title: fig. 44 — What can actually be tested

g.title: tie year and office span both known
office covers a year the tie was observed

g.text: Of 4,212 connected director-firm pairs, 688 (16.3%) carry both a tie year and an office span, and 326 of those overlap. `n_concurrent` is not a corrected `n_connected`: it is a much smaller, much better-evidenced
subset. Use it when the claim is about a live conflict of interest; use `n_connected` when the claim is about a firm recruiting from the political class, which does not require simultaneity.
